SessionStart prints this run's frozen session brief (lab brief → GET /api/runs/:ref/brief with the lab envelope and the run's LAB_RUN_TOKEN): the task, the project, the decisions that bind it, the skills on this box and the runbooks selected for it — the one thing a box receives (docs/distillation-runbooks-design.md §3). Outside a dispatched run it prints that there is none. `lab` (signal|remember|consult|applied|propose|runbook|recall) is the write half, documented in the CLI itself.
